name: Otome Party
source:
There is a short story prepared for each game character, but story is chosen according to gender and one of the five age categories selected. The contents varies from a child story about the kitten if woman is chosen to the nursing story about the hospital if an old man is chosen.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
游戏为每类角色都准备了一段短篇故事，具体内容取决于玩家选择的性别以及五个年龄段之一。不同组合会看到截然不同的故事：例如选择女性与年幼年龄段时，内容是关于小猫的童话；选择老年男性时，则会变成医院里的看护故事。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
